name: Love sticky rice
summary: Love sticky rice, the sticky rice served at the Ban Ang village meal.
origin: Ban Ang. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism lists “xôi tình yêu” with leaf-yeast wine and bamboo-tube fish. The winter handbook repeats the name in the Thai set.
howToEat: Eat it with the Ban Ang meal. A filling and a dye were not printed. Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43. The winter handbook also names it among Thai dishes and does not give a second village.
seoTitle: Xoi tinh yeu in Moc Chau — Ban Ang sticky rice
seoDescription: Love sticky rice, the sticky rice served at the Ban Ang village meal.
